1:
[ups.cp1500]
  driver = usbhid-ups
  port = auto
  desc = "CyberPower CP1500 AVR UPS"
  vendorid = 0764
  productid = 0501
  serial = ${UPS_SERIAL_0}
[ups.cp1500lcd]
  driver = usbhid-ups
  port = auto
  desc = "CyberPower PR1500LCDRT2U UPS"
  vendorid = 0764
  productid = 0601
  serial = ${UPS_SERIAL_1}

DEADTIME 25
MAXAGE 25
SHUTDOWNCMD "/sbin/shutdown -h +0"
POWERDOWNFLAG /etc/killpower
POLLFREQ 15
POLLFREQALERT 5
HOSTSYNC 15

[monuser]
  password = secret
  upsmon slave
[monmaster]
  password = secret
  upsmon master

face_recognition:
  enabled: true
go2rtc:
  streams:
    front_door_fullres:
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0#backchannel=0 # connect directly to main camera stream, no 2-way
    front_door:
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=1#backchannel=0 # connect directly to sub stream, no 2-way
    front_door_twoway:
      - rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=1 # Connect to substream for lower bandwidth
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0#audio=opus
    front_door_twoway_fullres:
      - rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0 # Connect to fullres
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0#audio=opus
    garage:
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://thingino:thingino@192.168.99.113:554/ch0
    garage_sub:
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://thingino:thingino@192.168.99.113:554/ch1
    back_door:
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://thingino:thingino@192.168.99.152:554/ch0
    back_door_sub:
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://thingino:thingino@192.168.99.152:554/ch1

  webrtc:
    candidates:
      - 192.168.99.0/24:8555
      - 10.42.0.0/16:8555
      - stun:8555
mqtt:
  host: mosquitto
cameras:
  front_door:
    enabled: true
    live:
      streams:
        front_door_fullres: front_door_fullres
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-aac
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/front_door
          roles:
            - detect
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/front_door_fullres?video&audio
          roles:
            - record
    detect:
      width: 640
      height: 480
      fps: 5
    snapshots:
      enabled: true
      required_zones:
        - porch
    record:
      enabled: true
    # events:
        # required_zones:
        #   - porch
    # rtmp:
    #   enabled: false
    motion:
      mask:
        - 519,480,640,480,640,480,640,480,640,90,640,0,518,0,525,276
        - 0,255,0,165,640,158,640,254
        - 0,236,640,230,640,0,0,0
    zones:
      porch:
        coordinates: 0,480,517,480,525,264,0,229
        objects:
          - person
  garage:
    enabled: true
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-aac
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/garage_sub?video&audio
          roles:
            - detect
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/garage?video&audio
          roles:
            - record
    detect:
      width: 640
      height: 480
      fps: 5
    snapshots:
      enabled: true
    record:
      enabled: true
    # events:
        # required_zones:
        #   - porch
    # rtmp:
    #   enabled: false
    motion:
      mask: 0.72,0.918,0.979,0.915,0.981,0.991,0.721,0.99
  back_door:
    enabled: true
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-aac
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/back_door_sub?video&audio
          roles:
            - detect
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/back_door?video&audio
          roles:
            - record
    detect:
      width: 640
      height: 480
      fps: 5
    snapshots:
      enabled: true
    record:
      enabled: true
detectors:
  cpu1:
    type: cpu
record:
  # Optional: Enable recording (default: shown below)
  enabled: true
  # Optional: Number of days to retain recordings regardless of events (default: shown below)
  # NOTE: This should be set to 0 and retention should be defined in events section below
  #       if you only want to retain recordings of events.
  # Optional: Event recording settings
  alerts:
    retain:
      days: 10
    pre_capture: 5
    post_capture: 5
  detections:
    retain:
      days: 10
    pre_capture: 5
    post_capture: 5
